segments.segment_summary: A farmer gets out of his tractor at sunset to stretch his legs and inspect the planter. He digs in the soil to check seed depth and looks over the machinery before getting back in.

key_moments.caption: A man steps out of his tractor into a field, with the sun setting behind the machinery.
A hand digs in the dark soil with a blue tool, revealing a single seed.
Close-up of the planter's row units and wheels as the man inspects them.
The man leans against the back of the tractor, looking at the complex hydraulic system.

segments.segment_summary: Working at night, the farmer pulls his tractor alongside a seed tender to refill the planter. He uses a remote control to operate the tender's auger, which pours seeds into the planter's hopper.

key_moments.caption: View from inside the tractor cab at night, showing the navigation screens and the field illuminated by headlights.
A close-up of a digital screen in the cab shows that 90.12 acres have been planted.
The farmer, outside at night, uses a remote to turn on a light and operate the seed tender's auger.
Seeds pour from a large hose into the yellow hopper of the planter.
